name: Sign up and start with a clean private budget
covers: compact mobile login and sign-up layout
empty financial records on new account
six-digit email verification on email/password signup and login
eight-character minimum for new signup passwords
eight-character minimum for password reset and recovery
server-side OTP request limits by email and source IP
verified active Brevo sender selected without a hardcoded address
six-digit verification validation and digit paste handling
failed signup email delivery does not leave an unusable account
single-use verification code with ten-minute expiry
trusted device bypass for thirty days
Google sign-in option is not shown while unavailable
Apple and Facebook sign-in options are not shown
Settings does not show a Linked accounts section
forgot password sends six-digit code by email
password reset code expiry and one-time use
verified reset code unlocks new password form
Home monthly spending card opens expense transactions
Home month chip opens monthly reports
Home earnings tile opens income transactions
Home bills and spend tile opens expense transactions
Home budget progress category rows open their budget detail sheet
description: Creates a new account and verifies its private finance workspace loads and persists.
steps: Open the app and continue past the introduction
Verify the Log In form fits within a standard phone viewport without horizontal overflow and no unavailable social sign-in option is shown
Switch to Sign Up and verify the four fields, terms checkbox and create button remain visible in the compact layout without unavailable social sign-in options
Attempt to sign up with a seven-character password and verify the form rejects it before requesting a code
Create an account with a valid email and a password of at least eight characters
Verify the six-digit code delivered to that email using the six input boxes or paste
Select Trust this device for 30 days and submit the code
Complete currency and monthly income setup for the first account
Sign out, sign in with email and password, and verify a code is requested on an untrusted device
Sign in and open Home, Transactions and Budgets
Refresh the page
On Home, tap the monthly spending card and verify Expenses transactions opens
Return Home and tap the month chip; verify Reports opens with Month selected
Return Home and tap Earnings; verify Income transactions opens
Return Home and tap Bills & spend; verify Expenses transactions opens
Return Home and tap a Budget progress category row; verify its budget detail sheet opens
expected: The new account sees its own zeroed starting workspace and every highlighted Home dashboard card and category row opens its relevant detail or list view.

name: Create, read, update and delete transactions
description: Verifies transaction CRUD and confirms dependent totals refresh after every saved change.
steps: Sign in and add an expense with amount, category, account, note and date
Verify it appears in Transactions and open its details
Edit the amount and note and save
Verify Home and Reports reflect the edited transaction
Delete the transaction and confirm
Refresh and verify the transaction remains deleted and totals remain updated
expected: The transaction is created, listed, edited and deleted; refreshed views and dependent totals match the saved records.

name: Manage budgets, accounts and categories with complete CRUD
covers: account read through tappable detail sheet
account update including balance from detail sheet
category read through tappable detail sheet
budget read through tappable detail sheet
budget edit and delete from detail sheet
savings goal update saved amount and target date
savings goal data isolation by user
description: Verifies each management screen exposes reliable controls for creating, reading, editing and deleting saved records.
steps: Open Budgets and create a monthly category limit
Edit that limit, save it and verify the updated amount
Delete the test budget and confirm it disappears
Open Settings and add a temporary account and category
Tap the account row to open its details sheet, choose Edit, change its name and balance, then save
Tap the category row to open its details sheet, choose Edit, change its name and save
Tap a budget row to open its details sheet, edit the limit, then reopen the sheet and delete the test budget
Delete both unused test records after confirmation
Open the Savings goals section and create a goal with a name, target amount, saved amount and target date
Verify the goal card displays its saved amount and progress percentage
Open the goal, update its saved amount and target date, then save
Refresh and verify the updated goal and progress remain visible
Open the goal again, choose Delete goal and confirm
Verify the deleted goal no longer appears
expected: Budgets, accounts, categories and savings goals support their expected CRUD workflows; savings progress and edits persist after refresh, and deletions require confirmation.

name: Reject invalid transactions and isolate private data
description: Ensures invalid writes are blocked and authenticated users cannot see another user's finance records.
steps: Sign in and open Add Transaction
Submit with an empty or zero amount and verify validation prevents saving
Sign out and verify the sign-in screen appears
Sign in as a different test account and open Transactions
expected: Invalid transaction data is rejected, signed-out users cannot access finance screens, and a second account sees only its own records.

name: Create and manage bill reminders
covers: bill reminder due date and lead-time selection
bill reminder update and delete with confirmation
description: Verifies bills can be scheduled, tracked, marked paid, edited and deleted without exposing another user's reminders.
steps: Open Home and add a bill with a name, amount, due date and reminder lead time
Verify the bill appears in Bill reminders with the correct amount and due status
Open the bill, change its due date and reminder lead time, then save
Verify the updated bill and reminder state appear after refresh
Mark the bill as paid and verify its status changes to Paid
Mark it unpaid again, reopen it, delete it and confirm
Verify the deleted bill no longer appears
expected: Bill reminders persist across reloads, reflect upcoming/overdue/paid states, and support safe editing and confirmed deletion.

name: Save preferences and export financial records
covers: profile photo upload with file type and size validation
uploaded profile photos are center-cropped to a square before storage
header and profile-card avatars use fixed circular clipping with centered cover images
profile avatar shared across Settings and all screen headers immediately after upload
profile photo helper text wraps without clipping and remains clear of fixed navigation
Linked accounts section is absent from Settings
Unavailable Google sign-in option is not shown
CSV export respects current transaction filters and escapes values safely
PDF report includes branded header, date, currency, income, expenses, net cash flow and visible transaction details
description: Verifies profile preference updates and report exports remain available after the CRUD improvements.
steps: Open Settings and change the full name and email address, then save profile details
Verify the name is saved and a confirmation email is requested for the new email address

Upload a non-square JPG, PNG or WebP profile photo no larger than 5 MB and verify it is center-cropped to a square and shown without stretching in the perfectly circular Settings profile card and top-right avatars on Home and other screens immediately without refreshing

Open Settings on a phone viewport and verify the profile photo helper text sits directly below the profile card, wraps within the screen padding, and is not covered by the Update password button, floating add button or bottom navigation
Open Change password, enter a new password and matching confirmation, then save
Verify mismatched passwords are rejected without changing the account password
Change currency and monthly income, save preferences and refresh
Verify the saved profile details and preferences remain selected
Open Transactions, apply a category and date filter, then export CSV and verify only matching rows and correctly quoted values are included
Use Export PDF and verify the print preview contains the BudgetBuddy report heading, prepared date, currency, income, expense and net totals, and the visible transaction table
Close print preview and verify the app returns to its normal screen
expected: Profile name and photo persist, email changes require inbox confirmation, password changes validate matching entries, preferences persist, CSV contains only visible filtered transactions with correctly escaped values, and the print-ready PDF report shows accurate totals and transaction details.

name: Filter transactions by category and date range
description: Verifies transaction search and combined category and date filters narrow the list correctly and can be reset.
steps: Sign in to a test account and create an expense with a distinctive note, category and date
Open Transactions and search for the distinctive note; verify the matching transaction appears
Select the transaction's category and set From and To dates that include its date
Verify the matching transaction remains visible and unrelated transactions are excluded
Change the date range so it excludes the transaction and verify the empty state appears
Tap Clear filters and verify the full transaction list returns
expected: Search, type, category and date filters work together, exclude non-matching records, and Clear filters restores the unfiltered transaction list.
